concerns.text: Task T101 is marked `[P]` (parallel‑safe) but it creates the project directory skeleton that downstream tasks (e.g., T103, T104) depend on. Running T101 in parallel with any consumer would cause race conditions, violating the parallel‑safety guarantee.

Task T102 is marked `[P]` yet it materializes contract schema files which are later validated by tasks such as T111 and T112. These consumers require the schemas to exist beforehand, so T102 cannot be safely executed in parallel with them.
